WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS biz_date,
         o.status, o.fulfilment_type
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
)
SELECT CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 'web' WHEN store_id=999 THEN '999' ELSE 'store' END AS grp,
       staff_purchase_flag, category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(net_amount) AS net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL AND store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_no_order
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.biz_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.line_count,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order o
), w AS (
  SELECT web.*, do.fiscal_year AS o_fy, do.fiscal_week AS o_wk, dd.fiscal_year AS d_fy, dd.fiscal_week AS d_wk
  FROM web LEFT JOIN dim_date do ON do.calendar_date = web.order_date LEFT JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = web.dispatch_date
)
SELECT status,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o_fy='FY2026/27' AND o_wk BETWEEN 1 AND 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_by_order_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d_fy='FY2026/27' AND d_wk BETWEEN 1 AND 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_by_dispatch_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY receipt_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_key)>1)) AS multi_store_receipts
FROM w GROUP BY status ORDER BY 1

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
         s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS store_atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS web_atv
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount,
         CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
         s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
    AND s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS store_atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS web_atv
FROM lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
